changes.before: Wide shot a householder seated in a small boat watching a family load crates onto a flat cargo boat, cloudy daylight. Britain in the 1660s: mature householders wear wool cloaks, breeches or aprons; handmade wood or stone structures if present, no school uniforms
changes.after: Medium shot at a Thames river landing on 2 September 1666, one unmistakably adult resident in a plain wool coat and knee breeches lifts one wooden household chest over the low gunwale of a broad flat cargo lighter moored beside the bank; the chest is visibly entering the boat, with a few plain boxes already on its flat deck, overcast daylight and simple brick riverside houses behind
